reviews.text: The staff were very kind and welcoming, and my dog ​​was happy to enter the shop! The grooming was done exactly as I wanted, and the scent and fluffiness are fantastic!
She came back with a big smile and a fluffy, smooth skin!

We've been using their services for a long time, and they've always been very accommodating of our various requests. When our dog comes back from grooming, she's always so fluffy and soft, which is a real treat for us. When we go out or take her for a walk, people often comment on how fluffy and cute she is. Our dog is also very excited; when we say, "It's grooming time!", she jumps into her outing backpack. We're extremely satisfied!

I always ask my beloved dog Mel's Grooming Cut ✂️ to sit my cats, and I feel completely at ease knowing that I can trust them with every cat.
Whenever I walk Mel and we pass by Nihonbashi Club, she always eagerly tries to get in. 🐶🐾

Thank you as always.

I always use your shampoo and herbal pack services!

The herbal pack seems to be very effective; my dog ​​always smells fresh and her fur is fluffy!

The staff are all very kind, and my dog ​​is always relaxed and happy♪
I look forward to seeing you again!

I've been a customer for several years now.

The kind staff always take care of my dog, which is why I always come here.

The shop's treats are carefully selected, and I occasionally buy some; my dog ​​loves them and says they're delicious! They also provide thorough updates with photos when my dog ​​is in their care. I'll definitely be back.
The female staff always greet us and are very kind. Thank you for always taking such good care of our Shiba Inu, who is a woman who is afraid of dogs but loves dogs.

We've been using their services since our dog was a puppy. Even when he was less than six months old, we consulted with them and they did a partial trim for him. I feel bad for always making so many requests, but they always listen carefully and make him look adorable just as I ask! My dog ​​loves to play but gets bored easily, but they apparently let him play in between trims, so he looks happy when I pick him up. Once, there was a spot on his paw pads that wasn't trimmed well, but when I contacted them, they fixed it right away. We look forward to continuing to use their services in the future.
I am very grateful for the excellent result.
I am always satisfied with the clean shampoo.

I've used the service three times.
◯The first time was good.
◯The second time, they were supposed to cut my dog ​​in two hours, but by 4pm I hadn't heard anything back, so when I contacted them they were late.
When I went to pick him up, they said my dog ​​had cut his hand, and offered to pay for any medical expenses.
In fact, there were deeper cuts in places other than the one they explained to me, and he was in pain for about a week.
◯The third time, there were a lot of hairballs, so the haircuts were split over two days. When paying, they didn't give me a breakdown, and when I asked they said it was 7,000 yen for hairballs.

This salon generally tries to hide something.
They seem like nice people, so they probably don't mean any harm, but could they please put themselves in the customer's shoes a little more?

I called to make a reservation for temporary childcare.

Unfortunately, the pick-up time was 4:30, so I decided against using the service. However, the phone service was very pleasant, and I would definitely like to use it again if the opportunity arises.

From reading everyone's reviews, it seems there are both good and bad staff members. When I called, I unfortunately got one of the bad ones. I tried to register through the reservation form because it's a membership-based service, but I got an error and couldn't register, so I called. Despite this, I was given a very unfriendly response: "You don't need to register for temporary boarding." I thought their website was confusing, but there was no point in arguing, so I confirmed, "So, for temporary boarding, I just need to call and make a request without registering?" They replied, "Yes, but sometimes we're fully booked with other dogs on the same day." I couldn't understand why they were in business. Reading how they respond to other people's reviews, I also feel that their customer service is questionable. I'm glad I didn't leave my dog ​​there. I suspect there are many good staff members, so I think the shop is getting bad reviews because of a few. I hope they will improve.
